services.design.description: I take care of design and development, from your first idea to launch. A website that reflects your business, tells its story clearly and gives visitors a natural next step.
services.development.description: Movement that guides the eye. A detail that responds to a gesture. A transition worth noticing. I build interactions that give your site character and make the visit memorable.

Your business has its own story.

method.label: 02 / WORKING TOGETHER
method.aside: A CLEAR DIRECTION, AT EVERY STEP.
method.title:
Good work starts
with a conversation.
method.step1.label: 01 / UNDERSTAND
method.step1.title: Understand your project.
method.step1.description: We talk about your business, your ideas and your constraints. That first conversation is free, with no commitment. From there, we agree on the scope, budget and steps ahead.
method.step1.output: A clear brief before the work begins.
method.step2.label: 02 / SHAPE
method.step2.title: Find the right direction.
method.step2.description: I propose a visual direction, then we refine it together. Layouts and early interaction studies let you see where the site is heading before development starts.
method.step3.label: 03 / BUILD
method.step3.title: Bring it to life. Keep it moving.
method.step3.description: I build the site, check it across screen sizes and prepare it for launch. Afterwards, I stay available for maintenance, updates and the next things you want to do.

about.name: Nicolas Kulpa-Hurault
about.identity:
Freelance web designer & developer.
Based in France, working remotely worldwide.
about.intro: I’m Nicolas, a freelance web designer and developer. I enjoy getting to know a business, finding what makes it interesting and turning that into a web experience. I’m open to projects in any industry: each one is a chance to discover a different world and give it a fitting expression online.
about.backend: I care about the whole experience and the details that shape it: a typeface, a rhythm, an interaction. You work directly with me before the build, throughout the process and after launch.
about.note1: 01 One point of contact, from design to development.

Built from
good material.
credits.sculpture: Head scan: Lee Perry-Smith / Infinite-Realities, CC BY 3.0. Geometry cropped, closed and separated into sections; materials, lighting and interaction adapted for this study. This is a sculptural asset, not the developer’s portrait.
credits.assets: Rendering: Three.js (MIT). Typography: Manrope (SIL OFL). Soins Essentiels and Sunday are shown through screenshots of the projects. The chess cover is a generated editorial illustration. The optimisation graphic shows results from the Python program.
credits.data: Sunday uses nflverse statistics, CC BY 4.0. The project is independent of the NFL. Each case study identifies its context and the origin of its visuals.
